purpose: Prospectively test whether a frozen local extract-or-abstain verifier restores answer-bearing recall while retaining adversarial no-answer rejection, and whether the strongest previously frozen FRC selector establishes utility beyond non-FRC methods under the identical shared verifier decision.

theoretical_mechanism.name: shared_extractive_support_gate_plus_transferred_adaptive_argmax_frc_v59
theoretical_mechanism.extract_or_abstain: The frozen local model must copy the shortest contiguous paragraph span that directly answers the question, or return exactly UNSUPPORTED when no such span exists.
theoretical_mechanism.support_parse: UNSUPPORTED maps to rejection. A non-empty output that occurs as a contiguous case-insensitive substring of the paragraph maps to support. Any other output is invalid, fails closed to rejection, and counts against the invalid-output gate.
theoretical_mechanism.shared_gate: The one case-level decision is reused unchanged for every token budget and gated selector.
theoretical_mechanism.candidate_selector: Reuse adaptive_argmax_cardinality_frc_v43 exactly, selected prospectively because it was the strongest same-gate FRC family member in the allowed v58 aggregate report.
theoretical_mechanism.family_claim: The primary selector claim is FRC-family feasibility against non-FRC methods, not novelty over all earlier FRC variants; therefore other frozen FRC methods are a non-inferiority safety comparison.

source_and_split.development_source: train-v2.0.json after excluding every v58 development source-case commitment

access_order: Freeze this protocol, implementation, prompt, parser, disjoint-sampling rule and synthetic invariants before constructing the new train sample.
Hash and validate the existing v58 source registration and source bytes without opening dev.
Read only v58 source-case commitment hashes to construct the exclusion set; do not read v58 case queries, candidates, scores, predictions, gold rows or evidence.
Parse train through the frozen source reader and construct a new 600-case blind sample with zero commitment overlap.
Register blind caches, runtime and model hashes before BGE scoring or Qwen generation.
Complete every score and extractive-support row before joining answer state or gold intervals.
Open dev exactly once only when every development gate passes; otherwise publish closure and keep dev unopened.

blind_task.case_answer_state_and_gold: Identical SQuAD 2.0 schema and deterministic evidence-unit construction to frozen v58.
blind_task.model_visible_verifier_input: Current question and full provided paragraph only.
blind_task.model_visible_retrieval_input: Current question and deterministic paragraph units only.
blind_task.forbidden: Raw ids, title, is_impossible, answers, plausible_answers, v58 case artifacts and gold intervals.

models.support_verifier_hash_contract: Identical nine-file SHA-256 manifest to frozen v58 protocol and execution registration.

frozen_atomic_queries: Identical four deterministic v58 BGE queries; no query generation model.

methods.shared_gate_non_frc: All five frozen v49 non-FRC selectors under the identical extractive support decision.
methods.same_gate_frc_safety_controls: All frozen v49 FRC methods other than adaptive_argmax_cardinality_frc_v43, including low_core_divergence_guarded_frc_v49.

evaluation.answer_metric: Exact evidence-unit set F1 against official answer-overlap units; not answer-string EM/F1.
evaluation.verifier_metric: Balanced accuracy, answer-bearing span pass rate, no-answer rejection rate and invalid-output rate.

scope_limits: Balanced public closed-paragraph mechanism evidence; not official answer-string scoring, hidden-test submission, open-corpus retrieval, SetR reproduction, flood-domain validation or rollout authorization.
